title: CompassHud-client
description: CompassHud adds a convenient on-screen HUD compass, similar to those in modern games (such as PUBG). It helps you easily navigate using cardinal directions during gameplay.
body:
![Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2124f008b3c5f9c230e24accd24e546d89b45f14.png)


CompassHUD brings a modern FPS-style HUD compass directly into Minecraft (Forge 1.20.1), inspired by games like PUBG. It provides a clean and minimal on-screen directional display, helping players navigate faster and stay oriented at all times. Perfect for PvP, survival, and server gameplay where quick awareness matters.

You can easily toggle the compass visibility on and off by binding a custom key in the standard controls settings.
